summary.text: Shykira Smith is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 63, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Hurchel Caldwell (R).

paragraphs.text: Shykira Smith ran for Oklahoma House District 63 in 2022 and again in 2024, losing both general elections to incumbent Hurchel Caldwell (R).
